sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः । प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
hindiTranslation: जो मनुष्य अधिभूत, अधिदैव और अधियज्ञके सहित मुझे जानते हैं, वे युक्तचेता मनुष्य अन्तकालमें भी मुझे ही जानते हैं अर्थात् प्राप्त होते हैं ॥
englishTranslation: Those who know me together with the physical realm, the radiant powers, and the inner sacrifice know me even at the time of death.
essence: Complete understanding remains steady even at the moment of departure.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Those who understand Krishna as present in the physical world, the divine powers, and the ritual offering remember him even at death.
simpleInsight: What you understand of Krishna in life can stay with you at the moment of death.
detailedMeaning: After Krishna has explained the deeper structure of reality, he gives Arjuna the final key: the one who understands him in every layer of existence does not lose that understanding at death. The teaching closes the chapter by tying knowledge to the last moment of life.
modernRelevance: At an ICU bedside, with monitors beeping and the family silent, a dying grandfather murmurs the name he chanted every morning for sixty years. Krishna says knowledge of him, held through life, stays present at the end.
translationLiteral: स-अधिभूत-आधिदैवम् (together with the physical realm and the radiant powers) / माम् (me) / स-अधियज्ञम् (together with the inner sacrifice) / च (and) / ये (those who) / विदुः (know) / प्रयाण-काले (at the time of departure/death) / अपि (even) / च (and) / माम् (me) / ते (they) / विदुः (know) / युक्त-चेतसः (those with a disciplined mind)
insight: Knowing Krishna in matter, in the gods, and in sacrifice keeps that knowledge alive even at the moment of death.

quoteVariants.text: Know the whole order of existence, and death cannot confuse you.
The end reveals what the whole life understood.
Know the whole, even at the end.
